title: acetosella regnellii
intro: Acetosella regnellii, commonly known as the red mountain cranberry or red mountain azalea, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family, Ericaceae. It is a shrub that is native to the high-altitude regions of South America and is valued for its potential health benefits and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues and urinary tract problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Acetosella regnellii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
